label: О нём
description: Prepositional sentences that train 'about him' after о/обо in real conversation.

missions.phrase: В деревне все говорят о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Being discussed. 'О нём' is the prepositional form of он after the preposition о, marking him as the topic. The plural 'говорят' reads as an impersonal 'people are talking'.

missions.phrase: Интересно, что они думают о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Others' opinion. 'О нём' is the topic of their thoughts, in the prepositional case after о. The embedded clause shows the construction inside reported thought.

missions.phrase: Я часто думаю о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Mental focus. 'Думать' takes о plus the prepositional case, so он becomes 'нём'. The adverb 'часто' adds frequency without touching the pronoun.

missions.phrase: Она написала песню о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Topic of a work. Here 'о нём' modifies the noun 'песню', naming what the song is about. Prepositional complements with о attach to nouns as well as verbs.

missions.phrase: Я читаю интересную книгу о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Subject matter. 'О нём' tells us what the book is about, staying prepositional after о. The construction names a work's subject.

missions.phrase: Соседи всё время спрашивают о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Polite inquiry. 'Спрашивать о ком-то' uses о plus the prepositional case, so он appears as 'нём'. This is how you say people keep asking after someone.

missions.phrase: Здесь о нём никто не знает.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negative frame. Even under the negation 'никто не знает', 'о нём' keeps its prepositional form. The никто... не pairing is obligatory in Russian.

missions.phrase: В городе все думают о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Broad subject. 'Все' gives a sweeping plural subject, while 'о нём' stays the fixed prepositional object of думать. The locative 'в городе' sets the scene.

missions.phrase: Жена очень заботится о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Care for someone. The verb 'заботиться' governs о plus the prepositional case, so он becomes 'нём'. A warm, common everyday pattern.

missions.phrase: Они уже всё рассказали о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past reporting. 'Рассказать о ком-то' keeps о plus the prepositional 'нём'. The past 'рассказали' surrounds the pronoun without changing its case.

missions.phrase: Недавно сняли фильм о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Topic of a film. 'О нём' names what the film is about and modifies the noun 'фильм'. The construction holds for any kind of work.

missions.phrase: Сегодня вышла статья о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Written about him. 'О нём' is the prepositional complement of 'статья', naming its subject. Such phrases fill titles, bios, and the press.

missions.phrase: Они знают о нём слишком много.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Object of knowledge. 'Знать о ком-то' takes о plus the prepositional 'нём'. 'Слишком много' adds an everyday evaluation while the pronoun stays fixed.

missions.phrase: У нас дома мало говорят о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Quantity of talk. 'О нём' is the topic of 'говорят', held prepositional by о. The quantifier 'мало' measures how much, not the case.

missions.phrase: На работе хорошо говорят о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Positive judgment. 'О нём' stays prepositional after о, while 'хорошо' colours how people speak. A natural way to report a good reputation.

missions.phrase: Мне интересно, что говорят о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative reaction plus reported speech. 'Мне интересно' frames the feeling with a dative experiencer, and 'что говорят о нём' carries the prepositional pronoun. Two structures combine cleanly.

missions.phrase: Я хорошо помню, что говорили о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Memory of speech. The verb 'помню' opens a clause where 'о нём' stays prepositional after о. Past 'говорили' is an impersonal plural.

missions.phrase: У меня есть вопросы о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Noun complement. 'О нём' modifies the noun 'вопросы', naming their subject. The existential 'у меня есть' gives a natural everyday frame.

missions.phrase: Друзья весь вечер спорят о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dispute over a topic. 'Спорить о ком-то' takes о plus the prepositional case, so он becomes 'нём'. The plural 'спорят' makes it sound like real social life.

missions.phrase: Я не хочу сейчас говорить о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Refusal to discuss. 'О нём' stays prepositional after о despite the chain 'не хочу говорить'. This negated-verb-plus-infinitive stacking is very natural in conversation.
